svg.title: Price per million tokens, Q2 2026
svg.desc: A horizontal bar chart of input and output prices per million tokens for seven models, from GPT-5.4 Nano at $0.20 input and $1.25 output to Claude Opus 4.7 at $5 input and $25 output. A table repeats the prices and shows that output costs 5 to 6.25 times input for every model listed.
